top_signals.title: Jensen Huang's affair with alleged spy revives push to tighten China chip curbs ahead of Trump-Xi summit

top_signals.title: Neste CEO Sees Renewable Diesel Demand Doubling
top_signals.summary:
Neste President and CEO Heikki Malinen says rising renewable fuel mandates are driving global demand and expects it to double by 2030. Malinen joined Insight with Haslinda Amin.

 (Source: Bloomberg)
